scope: Edit supplier invoice: keep payments, explicitly correct an existing paid payment, or save then confirm a separate additional payment.
auth: New functions are private standalone helpers; no additional public authentication setup.
behavior: A payable change with existing allocations requires an explicit payment choice.

Correct payment requires actual-payment confirmation and a selected related Paid payment. It adjusts this invoice allocation and the payment total to fully settle this invoice, preserving unrelated allocations.
Keep payment derives invoice Status from paid amount and new payable; never marks an unpaid increase as paid.
Additional opens the existing payment form for date, Own account, supplier account and amount confirmation; only that flow uses the new server-side add_payment action.
Invoice Edit_Request stores the immutable payment/accounting plans and a lease. Applied corrections resume; unsaved Prepared corrections remain discardable.
New payments and allocations have unique operation keys; lost create responses resume without duplicate amounts.
Existing unposted payment entries retain their identity and regenerate lines using the production payment accounting calculation, including reimbursable proration and rounding.
Payment/Invoice_Status and Invoice_Date allocation copies are refreshed for the edited invoice. Unrelated invoice allocations are preserved.
Rebuild all invoice settlement allocations after verified payment updates. Unpaid_Invoiced_Amount is a formula and is not written.
Posted/exported accounting, reconciled or locked payment corrections, ambiguous duplicate entries, mismatched totals and concurrent changes fail closed.
validation: 34 invoice editor/server/accounting regression tests pass with real Deluge source transpiled against an in-memory CRM.
2 additional-payment form recovery and duplicate-submit tests pass.
Related invoice registration and payment account/filter/date/operation tests pass.

Playwright Edge verifies the real editor and styles with mocked CRM, including all three payment choices, cancellation before writes, explicit actual-payment confirmation and 320/390/1440px popup layouts.
Zoho compiled all seven functions; published source read back and compared.
Production COQL payment accounting lookup syntax and unique field metadata verified using read-only queries.
No actual supplier invoice or payment was created or modified for testing.
remaining_live_validation: Upload the widget and verify an authorized real correction with each relevant option. No ZIP generated.
known_boundaries: Payment accounting identity follows existing source-generated Names ending in -PAY-id / PAY-MULTI-*id or the legacy Supplier_Payment_id form. Manually renamed entries without these identifiers cannot be linked reliably because Accounting_Entries has no Supplier_Payment lookup.
Existing general-purpose payment creation outside this invoice correction flow remains on its current path.
